idea-plugin.name: Phantom CPU Indicator
idea-plugin.description: CPU use of the IDE and of the whole machine in the status bar: a one-minute graph and the current numbers, highlighted while the IDE stays busy. Hover it to see what inside the IDE used the CPU in the last ten seconds (indexing, code analysis, GC, JIT, other), the busiest processes on the machine, and a link that saves a thread dump. Drawn without offscreen images and repainted only when a number or the graph changes; per-thread analysis runs only while the popup is open or the IDE is busy.
